# Input prompts

Unmodified PNG subset from **Kenney Input Prompts 1.5A**, CC0-1.0.
Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/input-prompts
Archive: https://kenney.nl/media/pages/assets/input-prompts/8de120163f-1783763952/kenney_input-prompts_1.5.zip
Original license included in `License.txt`.

Files are renamed for the frontend's stable asset identifiers. Xbox assets are
from `Xbox Series/Default/`, keyboard assets from `Keyboard & Mouse/Default/`.
Button A/B use the color outline variants; View/Menu use outline variants;
navigation uses dpad_all/arrows. Other keys use outline variants.

These are Kenney's glyphs, not a claim of Microsoft endorsement or certification.
